errors.description: The model incorrectly assumed that the duration of a shape is the difference between its appearance and disappearance timestamps, rather than the time it takes to fully draw. This is a wrong premise that misinterprets the task — the question asks for drawing duration, not on-screen persistence. The model also failed to recognize that shapes are drawn sequentially without overlapping, as implied by the Scene Description.

errors.description: The model assigned incorrect timestamps to shape appearances, starting at 0:01 instead of 0:00, and misaligned the sequence with the actual drawing durations. This suggests the model either misread the video’s timing or constructed a fictional timeline, compounding the perceptual error with temporal misalignment.

The model incorrectly calculated duration as a negative or zero value by subtracting start from end time without taking absolute value or recognizing that duration is end minus start. This reflects a fundamental misunderstanding of how to compute time intervals, which is exacerbated by the earlier perceptual and temporal errors.
